button.$description: The colors of each kind of button, the decisions every implementation of the button's spec makes alike. Its height, gap, radius and icon size are the control's.

primary.$description: The one action a view leads to: a fill of the interactive color, a step further from the page on hover and while pressed.

secondary.$description: Every other action: an edge in the field border on the page, raised on hover and while pressed, the edge lighter then.

ghost.$description: A minor action next to another: no edge, raised on hover and while pressed.

quiet.$description: An action that reads as a link: the interactive color, underlined.

danger.$description: An action that deletes or cannot be undone: an outline in the danger color in both themes, with its tint on hover and while pressed.

text.$description: The label of a disabled button of every kind.

border.$description: The edge of a disabled button of every kind that has one.
